name: Greenwake Seed
description: Throw a seed of living qi that sprouts into a stinging shoot on the target.

name: Sprout Skin
description: Grow a skin of fresh shoots over the arms that heals as it is cut.

name: Living Echo
description: Hear the slow echo of growing things and of former lives in the ground beneath.

name: Rooted Renewal
description: Root a mending vine in an ally's wound and let it knit flesh as it grows.

name: Bloom Return
description: Bloom a flower on an ally's skin that draws taint and poison up and out through the petals.

name: Seedling Step
description: Sink a seed of qi underfoot and sprout from a second seed a few paces away.

name: Evergreen Rise
description: Bring a newly fallen ally back on a rising green shoot of rebirth qi before the pulse is gone.

name: Verdant Lash
description: Lash a whip of living vine across the guard that roots in the wound it opens.

name: Perennial Shell
description: Wear a shell of perennial growth that drinks each blow and sends back green strength.

name: Perennial Rebirth
description: streams: Reincarnation + Life; bring back a newly fallen ally in a rush of green growth that heals their wounds.

name: Soulthread Dart
description: Throw a dart of soul-bright thread that tugs at the foe's balance on contact.

name: Soulthread Guard
description: Weave a guard of fine soul-thread that rings softly when struck.

name: Soulthread Reading
description: Follow a single soul-thread to learn whose it is and how firmly it is held.

name: Soulthread Lift
description: Lift a tired ally's soul-thread a little and ease the weight on the body.

name: Soulthread Mend
description: Knit a frayed soul-thread together so that the wounded body steadies and recovers.

name: Soulthread Bind
description: Tie a foe's soul-thread to the ground so the body stays where it stands.

name: Soulthread Cleanse
description: Comb the knots and tangles of erosion out of an ally's soul-thread.

name: Soulthread Step
description: Run along a soul-thread to its other end in a single bound.

name: Soulthread Raise
description: Draw a newly fallen ally's soul-thread back to the body and tie it off.

name: Soulthread Burst
description: Burst a web of soul-thread across the field that stings every foe it crosses.

name: Soulthread Anchor
description: Anchor the user's own soul-thread at the core and drink in the force of any blow.

name: Soul Reborn
description: streams: Reincarnation + Soul; draw a fallen ally's whole self back to the body and mend its wounds.
